summary: Review realtime and websocket paths for authorization, lifecycle cleanup, backpressure and fanout isolation.

must_inspect.why: Authorization should bind channel or topic subscription to current identity and scope.
false_positive_guards: Authenticated connection does not automatically authorize every topic.

must_inspect.why: Disconnects and reconnects should not leak subscriptions, tasks or stale identity.
false_positive_guards: Long-lived objects are not leaks if bounded and released on lifecycle events.

must_inspect.why: Slow consumers and fanout volume should not create unbounded queues or global failure.
false_positive_guards: Do not require the same policy for low-volume internal channels and public high-volume streams.
Static paths need runtime or load evidence for performance certainty.
